verdict.rationale: The axis applies: memory capacity and bandwidth for local LLM inference are fair questions for a desktop CPU. However, the pack never states a maximum addressable memory, a published memory bandwidth figure, or any 70B-class inference result. Intel's generic claim about maximizing AI PC LLM inference through oneDNN/PyTorch optimizations is a software building block, not evidence of practical large-model inference. The community note about DDR5-6400 as the rated speed gives a memory speed, not capacity or a published bandwidth sufficiency claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run a large local LLM (70B-class, quantized) on this platform — enough addressable memory and published memory bandwidth to make local inference practical
